newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK gold ends hint higher from New York close.
newsitem.headline: HK gold ends hint higher from New York close.

text.p: Hong Kong ended slightly higher on Thursday compared to New York's previous close after a session of two-way trade, bullion traders said.
Bullion ended at US$367.70/368.20 an ounce against New York's US$367.45/95 close on Tuesday.
Small amounts of physical buying were seen, some gold traders said. Other traders reported light Australian selling, although volumes were marginal.
Local gold ended HK$14 lower at HK$3,395 a tael.
The carryover charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society remained unchanged from its previous fix at -5.00
